Full summary: Triaged the 2026-08-15 field read-context-quality audit against 2.15.0 HEAD (12-cluster / 21-agent adversarially-verified workflow) and wrote the remediation plan: 4 release waves (2.16.0 data-safety+self-identification, 2.17.0 read-path honesty, 2.18.0 scope semantics, 2.19.0 payload contracts+verify), 9 named design decisions, and a field-communication track (send wave-2 memo first, separate response doc). Plan: docs/plans/2026-08-17-read-audit-remediation-plan.md; evidence: docs/plans/2026-08-17-read-audit-triage-evidence.txt.
Decisions: Chose a 4-wave release train (data-safety first, scope-matcher change isolated in its own release) over one mega-release — pre-tag adversarial review has caught majors 7 consecutive times and cannot digest a 40-item diff; the field needs bisection ability; Wave 1's live data-loss class must not wait on Wave 4 design work.; Chose to classify the report's ask 0a (publish >=2.13.0 to npm) as field-environment-only — npm view time proves npm latest was 2.13.0 on the audit date and 2.15.0 now; their npx served a stale 2.6.0 (registry age-policy or offline cache is the leading hypothesis, not proven); the surviving repo-side asks are server_version in tool responses and the PKG_SPEC pin design decision (DD-3).; Chose to honor the challenger downgrades: ASM-disclosure treated as fully OPEN (2.7/2.9 exclusion counts are a different disclosure axis than total_in_scope/omitted) and QUAL-lifecycle-rank as PARTIAL (deboost shipped 2.9.0 but the report's two cheaper preferred remedies — superseded_by on search rows, exclude_status — are open); treating either as done would have dropped real asks from the plan.; Chose to send the wave-2 ship memo first, unchanged except the stale line-183 fix, and answer the audit in a separate disposition doc — the memo is styled final with a clean archive condition and its upgrade step is itself the fix for the report's biggest observed class; bundling would blur both.; Chose to keep the named design decisions (file-wins precedence DD-8, verify content-hash DD-1, agent_id model DD-4, bundle embeddings DD-2, PKG_SPEC pin DD-3, record INVALID_INPUT DD-5 pending field error distribution, full read-only mode DD-6, archive retrieval DD-7, assemble floor size DD-9) OUT of the waves as explicit owner calls — the report itself files them as architectural, and file-wins carries a standing do-not-patch warning.
